description: This Java source file implements a custom view component called SlidingTabLayout, which provides a tab indicator for a ViewPager. It allows customizing tab appearance, colors, and behavior, serving as a UI navigation element in Android applications.

classes.name: SlidingTabLayout
classes.description: A custom view extending HorizontalScrollView that provides a sliding tab strip to work with ViewPager, enabling tab selection and indicator customization.

classes.name: SlidingTabLayout.TabColorizer
classes.description: An interface to customize indicator and divider colors for tabs.

methods.name: setCustomTabColorizer
methods.description: Sets a custom TabColorizer for controlling tab colors.

methods.name: setSelectedIndicatorColors
methods.description: Defines colors for the indicator that highlights the selected tab.

methods.name: setDividerColors
methods.description: Defines colors for the dividers between tabs.

methods.name: setOnPageChangeListener
methods.description: Sets a listener to respond to page change events in the ViewPager.

methods.name: setCustomTabView
methods.description: Specifies a custom layout for tab views, including layout resource ID and TextView ID.

methods.name: setViewPager
methods.description: Associates a ViewPager with the tab layout and populates tabs based on its adapter.

methods.name: createDefaultTabView
methods.description: Creates a default TextView for tabs if no custom layout is provided.

methods.name: populateTabStrip
methods.description: Fills the tab strip with tabs based on the ViewPager's adapter.

methods.name: scrollToTab
methods.description: Scrolls the tab strip to bring the specified tab into view.
